database.stem: Who is the intended audience of this advertisement?
database.raw_text:
Who is the intended audience of this advertisement?
(A) People who are in legal trouble
(B) Anyone who is having financial problems
(C) Businesses that are in need of tax breaks
(D) Workers who must do their yearly income taxes
database.explanation:
根据广告内容，可联想到因信用问题经济活动受制约的一类人。答案
是(B)。

options.A: People who are in legal trouble
options.B: Anyone who is having financial problems
options.C: Businesses that are in need of tax breaks
options.D: Workers who must do their yearly income taxes
